user_query: I am curious about the daily passage from the Bible. Can you provide me with the passage of the day, along with any additional notes, using the Passage of the Day API? Additionally, I would like to know the locations mentioned in the passage and their details using the Place Detail API.

TaskList.description: Fetch the daily passage from the Bible including any additional notes.
Extract the locations mentioned in the obtained daily passage.
Use the Place Detail API to gather detailed information about the extracted locations.
